summary: Tested Bulk IVR live engagement, the Results card, follow-ups, campaign summary emails and the email switch from start to finish (backend pytest 10/10 after one fix; Playwright desktop UI checks pass). Alice and Bob do NOT exist in this pod's DB (webAccounts has only civr.uxtest + one test_uxnew account), so I used civr.uxtest as the owner and a newly registered TEST_ intruder account as the 'other user'. What works: the live view refreshes every ~5s and Calls/min climbs early (0 -> 8 -> 14 -> 22 over about 17s with a 1.5s sim step), with a sensible Time left. Engagement numbers are correct (12 leads -> 5 reached, 3 listened 30s+, 3 hot). The Results card shows the reach cards, best hour and best area, plus the 'Re-call 4 unanswered' and 'tomorrow at 5 PM' buttons. A follow-up gets the same owner and followupOf set, and the page navigates to it. The other user gets 404 on GET and on followup, and no follow-up is created. A campaignDone email is logged in webEmailLog (_id campaign:<id>) with People reached and Hot leads, and no undefined/NaN. In the hot=0 email the Hot leads row is hidden while People reached and the "didn’t answer" tip still show. With the switch OFF no email is sent within 80s; turning it back ON sends one for the next campaign. The settings toggle saves and survives a reload. The email example preview renders cleanly, and 'Email me a test' works (preview toast). Node suites spot-checked: engagement 11/0, emails 40/0, i18n 6/0, paste 13/0. Bugs found: (1) [FIXED] follow-ups lost the dryRun flag. (2) [OPEN] a campaign that finishes while 'Campaign reports' is OFF gets emailed anyway once the switch is turned back ON (6h lookback).

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: createFollowup did not copy dryRun to the new campaign (createCampaign ignores it). In preview, the follow-up's 'Start calling' returned 400 'This campaign is not waiting to start.'. A 'best time tomorrow' follow-up was scheduled with dryRun unset, so the REAL scheduler (launchDueScheduledCampaigns, which looks for dryRun != true) would have picked it up and called startCampaign for real in preview. Fix: bulk-call-service.js createFollowup now sets dryRun: true when the parent campaign is dryRun.

OPEN: 'Campaign reports' OFF -> ON sends emails for campaigns that finished while it was OFF. send() returns false before it writes the webEmailLog key, and events() looks back 6h (completedAt >= max(since, now-6h)). Every tick re-checks the skipped campaign, so once the switch is ON again it gets emailed. Reproduced twice: TEST_eng_off finished at 22:21 with the switch OFF, the switch was turned ON at 22:23, and the email went out at 22:25. 'Recent emails' showed two 'Campaign report: 2 of 3 picked up' rows. Also applies to the voicemail and missed groups. Suggested fix: when a pref blocks an email, record the key (e.g. insertOne {_id:key, type, ok:'off'}) and exclude ok:'off' rows from /emails/log, or check that the pref was ON at completedAt.

minor.issue: The preview simulator never calls the engine's per-call handler. So the in-app notifications for hot leads, the 25/50/75% digests and the final report are never sent for simulated web campaigns (webNotifications stayed empty during my runs). I could only verify the 'no flood' and digest logic through the node unit test (test_bulkcall_engagement.js 11/0). The CampaignDetail page does show its own 'Hot lead: +1… pressed 1' toast from the feed.

In preview, spent, perPerson and perHot are null because there are no BulkIVR phoneLogs charges. So the 'cost per person' fact never shows in the Results card or the email in preview, and I could not verify it end to end.

The 30s minimum rate window still under-reports for the first 30s: 4 calls done in 6s show 8/min (true rate is about 40/min) and ETA 45s (true is about 9s). This is fine for real calls (which take 30s or more each), and it is far better than the old 5-min average.

issues: The stats row says 'No answer 2', but the follow-up button says 'Re-call 4 unanswered' because unanswered = no_answer + busy. Consider the label 'Re-call 4 unanswered/busy' or a hint.
The stats row shows 'Voicemail 3' while the Results card shows 'Voicemails left 0' (no VM drop audio). This is correct, but it can confuse users.

action_items: Fix the email-switch re-send: record or suppress the webEmailLog key when the user's pref blocks campaignDone, voicemail or missed, so turning a switch back ON does not send old emails (6h lookback).
Keep or confirm the dryRun copy in createFollowup (bulk-call-service.js) and consider persisting dryRun inside createCampaign itself, so other cloned campaigns (spawnNextRun etc.) can't lose it.
Optional: have campaign-sim.js emit the hot-lead, digest and final report notifications (or call the engine's per-call handler) so preview users see live engagement notifications.
Re-seed or recreate the Alice and Bob CloudIVR accounts in this pod's DB, or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: they currently don't exist (login returns invalid_credentials).
critical_code_review_comments: emails.js send(): an early return on a disabled pref without recording the key, together with the LOOKBACK re-scan, makes emails that should stay suppressed go out later.
bulk-call-service.js createFollowup: the 'keep' list includes dryRun, but createCampaign drops unknown fields, so the flag must be set afterwards (now done).
Results.js: the facts list is hidden entirely when spent is null and there is no bestHour or bestArea. That's fine, but consider showing 'cost shows once calls are billed' in preview.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10) after the dryRun fix; 1 open bug not covered by an assertion (switch OFF -> ON re-send)

seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_eng_* / TEST_ui_eng campaigns, their follow-ups and the test_intruder accounts were deleted by id. The uxtest emailPrefs.campaigns is left at true. webEmailLog preview rows for the test campaigns remain (180-day TTL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run in the FOREGROUND in two parts so each fits the 300s limit: pytest tests/test_cloudivr_engagement_email.py -p no:xdist -k 'sim or followup or preview or invalid', then -k 'no_hot or switch'. Background runs get killed when the bash call returns, which left the prefs OFF last time. The email scanner ticks every 60s. fast_finish() marks dry-run leads done in Mongo to finish a campaign at once. Sim outcomes cycle by lead index (key 34s, voicemail, no_answer, completed 18s, busy), so any sim with at least 1 lead has a hot lead; use fast_finish for hot=0. After the switch-resend bug is fixed, add an assertion that the OFF campaign never gets an email after the switch goes back ON.
rca of the issue: Switch re-send: emails.js events() picks campaigns with completedAt >= cursor (cursor = max(scanner.since, now-6h)) and run() skips only keys already in webEmailLog. send() returns false for a disabled group BEFORE insertOne, so no key is written, and the campaign comes back on every tick for 6h. Repro: turn the switch OFF, finish a campaign, wait one tick, turn the switch ON, and within 60s a campaignDone row appears. Follow-up dryRun: createCampaign builds its doc from a fixed field list, without dryRun. calls.js POST /campaigns adds dryRun afterwards, but createFollowup didn't.
